headline: ABC's updated count: more than 1,600 Delta flights delayed, per Delta.
summary: ABC updated its story (4:43 PM ET): citing Delta, more than 1,600 Delta flights were delayed Sunday and about 49% of Delta flights ran more than 15 minutes late. c006 now uses the updated figures; the earlier 1,300 count is superseded. No label changes.
author: Editor-in-Chief

headline: The Delta weight-and-balance outage is not established as a cyberattack; Delta gives no cause.
summary: New incident page. Sources read: ABC, WSB-TV, Simple Flying, NBC, Atlanta News First, Fox News (Tier 2). AP blocked automated access (only a search snippet read). Delta newsroom checked: no statement posted. FAA statement read only through press. Main question: Not established. Link to the FAA Nov 13 stop and United Nov 16 outage: Not established. Status monitoring until a root cause is published. Privacy check done: no bylines, handles or contact details.
author: Editor-in-Chief
